method.candidate_sequences: Reconstructed the ordered (edge_id, sign) sequence of each of the 36 Stage16 candidates having an exact Stage19 contiguous-loop match. Every Stage19 occurrence listed for a candidate was required to reconstruct the same candidate sequence.
method.worm_test: Exact ordered edge/sign equality against every cyclic contiguous segment of each of the 252 M55 worm-boundary Wilson loops, at each candidate length, testing both traversal orientations.
method.scope: Only the 36 Stage16 candidates already recoverable through Stage19 matches were tested. The 564 Stage16 candidates with no Stage19 contiguous match are not covered by this crosswalk.

results.interpretation: This is an exact finite combinatorial bridge between nine Stage16 candidates, their Stage19 loop occurrences, and nine M55 worm-boundary loops. The nine matches span all five worm families and are all three-edge subpaths. The family-3 count is four of 51 segments; the other family counts are one or two of approximately 50, so there is no basis for claiming family concentration. This does not establish a unique root-to-worm assignment, a directed observer trajectory, a physical lift, or a derivation of the 34:55 parastichy count.
